semantic_fidelity.reason: Critical missing direct nv-rms API paths to compute BMC, NVSwitch BMC and power shelf: LAN membership plus physical bus is not the requested distinct API fan. Redfish/HTTPS, explicitly qualified usually-air-gapped separation, exporter :9400/Prometheus, and plain visible host/off-rack residency are also omitted. Paid-only software is absent. Historical OOB→NVOS is overridden by later nuanced source.

arrow_traceability.reason: All drawn routes trace to correct distinct arrowheads. One shared v1 junction is the requested bus, not accidental merging. The gRPC detour is long but traceable; two documented rewrites failed routing, and no evidence establishes an available shorter obstacle-safe route in this configuration. Missing required routes are semantic failures, not traceability of existing lines.

layout_fit.reason: Each final spec has its own 77×47 natural pinned dump, no graph clipping; live headers show 82×51. However the rubric also requires complete source coverage across split views, and direct RMS-to-device edges and other source qualifiers are absent.

conceptual_grouping_color.reason: Tag names are not drawn. v1/v2 off-rack and hardware/software group borders use the same blue hue, leaving roles and separation unnamed; v3 in-band control and compute host have pink and teal families, but the host-residency tier is not identified in the captures. Source asks where software resides; the logical tags alone are not visible labels.

border_integrity.reason: All 14 node occurrences have complete sides and corners, continuously colored in normal ANSI and bold amber in select-all ANSI. The evidence is simultaneous selection, not separate interaction trials.

workflow_evidence.reason: Frozen hashes and independent identities are recorded, target fit and captured live sizes supported, frames and cleanup present. Required --require-records validation fails because line 8 stdout/stderr were overwritten. Reconstructed v1-a3 and v3-a1 source bytes further limit input provenance; generation discloses these. No passing log is available.

animation.reason: The case manifest marks animation optional, and the source requests no animation. Static captures show no dots; no origin/arrival evidence is applicable.

category_fit.evidence_line: The rack software lives in weakly-connected worlds joined by one named bus: the OOB LAN is 'a separate physical Ethernet network ... usually air-gapped from the data plane' whose every BMC hangs off it, while DCGM's 'whole job' is in-band and 'the only relationship to OOB is negative' (source lines 271/277).
verified_recipe_facts: v1 side-by-side areas with no group outlines
one OOB bus splits once into three distinct directed endpoints
v2 and v3 are separate views; the off-rack anchor repeats
four measured co-view failures and one label-free routable topology probe, with limits stated in critique
category_fit.reason: Dominant family and bus recipe are supported. Generator also explicitly claims the identity-probe-map secondary recipe; its recipe requires every identifier and qualifier covered in a named view and proven in captures. Prometheus :9400, Redfish/HTTPS and the usually-air-gapped qualification are absent, despite ledger entries. The co-view routing attempts support a limited renderer yield but do not substitute for the missing semantic edges or secondary recipe.

findings.description: DEFECT: requested direct per-device RMS API paths are missing; the physical OOB bus cannot substitute for direct calls.

DEFECT: Redfish/HTTPS on controller calls, REST qualification, exporter Prometheus :9400, and usually-air-gapped qualification are not visibly stated; absence of an OOB→DCGM edge preserves that negative fact but cannot express the separate qualified air-gap claim.
DEFECT: off-rack and device groups share blue and neither group has a visible role label; compute-host tier is not named in v3. Colored tags alone do not convey the source-named residency roles.

EVIDENCE GAP: line 8 raw stdout and stderr overwritten on label reuse; required attempts-record validation fails. Two archived specs are reconstructed rather than original checked bytes, per attempts.json.

DEFECT: the declared secondary identity coverage recipe is not met in captures; relevant qualifiers and identifiers are ledger-only or dropped. The evidenced routing yield cannot waive this or missing relations.
DEFECT: physical fit is proven in each pinned dump but required cross-view source coverage is incomplete.

blockers: Frozen renderer attempts fail to route the tested direct RMS device API plus single-split bus configurations; no successful combined view was recorded. This is a measured limited capability blocker, not proof that every possible split or layout is impossible.
Overwritten line-8 original stdout/stderr cannot be reconstructed from current frozen records; validator require-records fails.
The long gRPC detour was not shortened by two tested alternatives, which both failed routing; global optimality is not proven.
